::: {.callout-warning}
## Preview

This site is new and works only from the WHOI network or VPN. Please
[tell us](report.qmd) what is missing or wrong.
:::

The WHOI CMIP data server holds CMIP6 model output and atmospheric and ocean
reanalyses (ERA5, 20CRv3, GLORYS12V1, SODA3.12.2) on WHOI's VAST storage at
`{{< var vast_prefix >}}`, indexed by
[intake-esm](https://intake-esm.readthedocs.io/) catalogs. Other products on
the store are listed on [Holdings](holdings.qmd#other-holdings).

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Served from site/vendor/ (see vendor/vendor.yml) instead of jsDelivr.
vendor = (p) => new URL(`vendor/${p}`, document.baseURI).href
htl = require(vendor("htl/htl.min.js"))
html = htl.html
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
stats = FileAttachment("data/catalog_stats.json").json()
html`<div class="home-stats">
  <div><span class="stat-n">${stats.n_datasets.toLocaleString()}</span><span class="stat-label">datasets</span></div>
  <div><span class="stat-n">${(stats.n_files / 1e6).toFixed(1)} M</span><span class="stat-label">files</span></div>
  <div><span class="stat-n">${Math.round(stats.size_tb).toLocaleString()} TB</span><span class="stat-label">catalogued</span></div>
  <div><span class="stat-n">${stats.catalogs.length}</span><span class="stat-label">catalogs</span></div>
</div>`
```

::: {.grid}

### [Browse](browse.qmd)

Filter by model, experiment, variable, and more, then copy paths, URLs, or a
Python snippet. [Holdings](holdings.qmd) lists everything on the server.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.home-card}
### [Data access](access.qmd)

On HPC, over the SMB share, by HTTPS download
([download guide](download-guide.qmd)), through Globus, or from public cloud
mirrors. Use the [catalog](catalog.qmd) from Python.
:::
:::
